description: Transport Routes is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport for NSW. This API provides information about the operators which are contracted to Transport for NSW. It provides the route and service by Operator. This data is also considered a master (reference) list of transport routes and lines. Coverage: Transport for NSW. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for NSW. Its tags are Bus Routes, bus, bus lines, contract, management. It offers 3 resource(s) in API, CSV, PDF. The portal shows 2025-08-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
